notes:
Context: Northgate EvidenceWorks provides enterprise e-discovery and compliance search for mid-to-large law firms and corporate legal teams. Primary driver: replace brittle keyword workflows with vector+rerank pipeline to cut manual review time and surface prioritized docs. Wants a vendor that can run in VPC/private with strict audit retention.

Key quotes / call color: "We cannot ship anything that leaves our VPC for raw document content — audit logs are ok if pushed via secure gateway." AE note: customer repeatedly asked about per-query cost and deterministic P95 latency for attorney workflows.

Scale and performance requirements (from technical call 2026-02-18):
- Index target: 25M initial docs, plan to expand to ~100M within 12 months. Mixed text + PDF + extracted OCR.
- QPS target: sustained 120 qps during near-peak ingest queries; burst to 500qps for e-discovery runs.
- Latency targets: p50 <120ms for embedding lookup + rerank; p95 end-to-end <800ms for single-query rerank pipeline (embedding retrieval + in-memory reranker).
- Cost target: average end-user cost per search <$0.03 (aggressive), willing to trade some latency for savings via quantized models / batching.

Technical preferences and constraints:
- Wants hybrid retrieval: BM25 + ANN (HNSW) then rerank with lightweight cross-encoder (quantized 6B).
- Embedding model: open preference (localizable) — evaluating OpenEmbed-2.7B and a Redwood-verified 3B candidate. Must support 1536-d vectors, but open to 1024-d if cost/latency wins.
- Reranker: on-host GPU quantized cross-encoder; fallback to CPU-sparse rank for certain queries.
- Indexing: incremental, delta updates required. Need ability to snapshot+roll back index versions (for legal hold).
- Storage: encrypted at rest with customer-managed KMS / HSM.
- Audit/retention: immutable audit logs for 7 years for search access and model prompt traces; retention and export APIs required.
- Residency: EMEA subset of PII must remain in eu-central region.
- Identity: SSO via SAML + SCIM provisioning; role-based access controls for redaction jobs.

Procurement / commercial notes:
- Procurement prefers annual committed Dedicated or Private subscription. Budget signal: $300k ARR target for first-year commitment.
- Interested in Optimize add-on for batching/cost tuning; wants Redwood to provide cost/latency tradeoff report after POC.

Timeline / ask from Redwood:
- Provide POC pricing for 50M doc index (VPC-hosted) + options for fully air-gapped on-prem pricing.
- Deliver security artifact set (ISO27001 cert, SOC2 reports, KMS architecture diagram, data flow for audit logs).
- Provide guidance on expected per-query cost at target QPS and recommended quantization profile for 3B vs 6B reranker.

POC acceptance criteria (we captured):
- Index 50M docs with delta updates and validate snapshots/rollback flows.
- Achieve p95 end-to-end <800ms on rerank pipeline at 120 sustained qps in VPC.
- Demonstrate audit log export and 7-year retention simulation.
- Provide cost estimate within ±15% of projected run-rate.
